notes: Reads the live token from this host's own `gh auth login` session. Run `gh auth login` once on this host if it isn't already.

command:
set -euo pipefail
creds_file="$HOME/.claude/.credentials.json"
refresh_token=$(jq -r '.claudeAiOauth.refreshToken // empty' "$creds_file")
if [ -z "$refresh_token" ]; then
  echo "$creds_file: claudeAiOauth.refreshToken missing -- run \`claude\` and log in on this host first" >&2
  exit 1
fi
body=$(jq -n --arg rt "$refresh_token" '{client_id:"9d1c250a-e61b-44d9-88ed-5944d1962f5e",grant_type:"refresh_token",refresh_token:$rt,scope:"user:profile user:inference user:sessions:claude_code user:mcp_servers user:file_upload"}')
resp=$(curl -fsS -X POST https://platform.claude.com/v1/oauth/token \
  -H 'Accept: application/json, text/plain, */*' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'User-Agent: axios/1.15.2' \
  -H 'Connection: close' \
  -d "$body")
access_token=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.access_token // empty')
if [ -z "$access_token" ]; then
  echo "refresh response missing access_token" >&2
  exit 1
fi
new_refresh=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.refresh_token // empty')
if [ -z "$new_refresh" ]; then
  new_refresh="$refresh_token"
fi
mode=$(stat -c %a "$creds_file")
tmp="$creds_file.tmp"
jq --arg at "$access_token" --arg rt "$new_refresh" '.claudeAiOauth.refreshToken=$rt | .claudeAiOauth.accessToken=$at' "$creds_file" > "$tmp"
chmod "$mode" "$tmp"
mv "$tmp" "$creds_file"
echo "$access_token"
notes: Refreshes whichever account is logged into Claude Code on this host (~/.claude/.credentials.json). Run `claude` and log in once on this host first.

command:
set -euo pipefail
auth_file="$HOME/.codex/auth.json"
refresh_token=$(jq -r '.tokens.refresh_token // empty' "$auth_file")
if [ -z "$refresh_token" ]; then
  echo "$auth_file: tokens.refresh_token missing -- run \`codex login\` on this host first" >&2
  exit 1
fi
resp=$(curl -fsS -X POST https://auth.openai.com/oauth/token \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  --data-urlencode client_id=app_EMoamEEZ73f0CkXaXp7hrann \
  --data-urlencode grant_type=refresh_token \
  --data-urlencode refresh_token="$refresh_token" \
  --data-urlencode 'scope=openid profile email')
access_token=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.access_token // empty')
new_refresh=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.refresh_token // empty')
if [ -z "$access_token" ] || [ -z "$new_refresh" ]; then
  echo "refresh response missing access_token or refresh_token" >&2
  exit 1
fi
mode=$(stat -c %a "$auth_file")
tmp="$auth_file.tmp"
jq --arg at "$access_token" --arg rt "$new_refresh" '.tokens.access_token=$at | .tokens.refresh_token=$rt' "$auth_file" > "$tmp"
chmod "$mode" "$tmp"
mv "$tmp" "$auth_file"
echo "$access_token"
notes: Refreshes whichever account is logged into Codex on this host (~/.codex/auth.json). Run `codex login` once on this host first.

command:
/usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
import datetime
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request

from pathlib import Path

import dbus

try:
    bus = dbus.SessionBus()
    service = dbus.Interface(bus.get_object('org.freedesktop.secrets', '/org/freedesktop/secrets'), 'org.freedesktop.Secret.Service')
    unlocked, locked = service.SearchItems({'service': 'gemini', 'username': 'antigravity'})
    if not unlocked:
        raise ValueError('Antigravity login missing or keyring locked; run agy on the host and unlock the desktop keyring')
    if len(unlocked) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Multiple Antigravity keyring entries; resolve the host login first')
    _, session = service.OpenSession('plain', dbus.String('', variant_level=1))
    item = dbus.Interface(bus.get_object('org.freedesktop.secrets', unlocked[0]), 'org.freedesktop.Secret.Item')
    secret = item.GetSecret(session)
    stored = json.loads(bytes(secret[2]))
    token = stored['token']
    if stored.get('auth_method') != 'consumer' or not token.get('refresh_token'):
        raise ValueError('Expected an Antigravity consumer OAuth login; run agy on the host')
    data_dir = Path(os.environ.get('ORCA_PROXY_HOME') or Path.home() / '.orca-proxy')
    client = json.loads((data_dir / 'antigravity-oauth-client.json').read_text())
    for field in ('client_id', 'client_secret'):
        if not isinstance(client.get(field), str) or not client[field].strip():
            raise ValueError('Missing Antigravity OAuth client configuration')
    body = urllib.parse.urlencode({
        'client_id': client['client_id'],
        'client_secret': client['client_secret'],
        'grant_type': 'refresh_token',
        'refresh_token': token['refresh_token'],
    }).encode()
    request = urllib.request.Request('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', data=body)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
        result = json.load(response)
    access = result.get('access_token')
    if not isinstance(access, str) or not access or any(ord(c) < 33 or ord(c) == 127 for c in access):
        raise ValueError('OAuth refresh response missing a valid access_token')
    lifetime = int(result['expires_in'])
    if lifetime < 1800:
        raise ValueError('OAuth token lifetime shorter than credential cache TTL')
    token.update(access_token=access, token_type=result.get('token_type', 'Bearer'), expires_in=lifetime,
                 expiry=(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) + datetime.timedelta(seconds=lifetime)).isoformat())
    if result.get('refresh_token'):
        token['refresh_token'] = result['refresh_token']
    payload = dbus.ByteArray(json.dumps(stored).encode())
    item.SetSecret((session, dbus.ByteArray(b''), payload, 'text/plain'))
    print(access)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
    print(f'Antigravity OAuth refresh failed (HTTP {exc.code}); check the host agy login', file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
except Exception:
    print('Antigravity credential unavailable; check the host agy consumer login, unlocked keyring, python3-dbus and antigravity-oauth-client.json', file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
PY
notes: Refreshes the Linux Antigravity CLI (agy) consumer login in the host desktop Secret Service keyring (service=gemini, username=antigravity). Requires python3-dbus and an unlocked session keyring, plus antigravity-oauth-client.json in the Jetty data directory. Run agy and sign in on the host first; no live tokens belong in the VM.

Reads AWS process-format JSON from a host AWS CLI v2 profile. Change default to your dedicated, permission-scoped profile; log in on the host if required. Use an AWS SigV4 rule with an explicit service and region. Temporary credentials refresh before expiration.
